Lees vóór je aanmelding de uitgebreide informatie op de website van [Speedcubing Nederland](http://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2019). Er is een beperkt aantal bedden voor gasten. Before you register, please read the detailed information on the website of [Speedcubing Nederland](http://www.kubuswedstrijden.nl/kubusweekend2019). There is a limited number of beds available for guests. Guests will pay the same price as competitors. It is possible to visit the competition as a visitor during the events, but all visitors must be registered. Visitors will not pay a fee, but cannot use the food and drinks.

items.information: El torneo se realizará en el Salón Principal de la Escuela Técnica de Artes Visuales Cristóbal Rojas, en Caracas, Distrito Capital. **[URGENTE] Nos entristece profundamente saber que Venezuela ha sufrido un gran corte de energía desde el jueves por la noche, hora local. Las escuelas están cerradas por el día y se ha ordenado a los trabajadores que se queden en casa.** **Como hay un concurso programado para este fin de semana en Caracas, nos gustaría anunciar que existe la posibilidad de que [Cubearte Caracas 2019] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) sea cancelado. Los competidores que se hayan inscrito recibirán un correo electrónico sobre este asunto en breve.** **Nos gustaría extender nuestras condolencias a Enrymar Cisneros (Candidato Delegado de WCA - Venezuela) y amigos en Venezuela. Se publicará una actualización sobre este asunto tan pronto como sea posible.** ***WCA Competition Announcement Team*** ______ The competition will be held at Escuela Tecnica de Artes Visuales Cristobal Rojas Main Hall, on Caracas, Capital District. **[URGENT] We are deeply saddened to learn that Venezuela has been under a major power outage since Thursday evening local time. Schools are closed for the day and workers have been ordered to stay at home.** **As there is a competition scheduled to be held in Caracas this weekend, we would like to announce that there is a possibility [Cubearte Caracas 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) will be cancelled. Competitors that have registered will be emailed about this matter shortly.** **We would like to extend our condolences to Enrymar Cisneros(WCA Candidate Delegate - Venezuela) and friends in Venezuela. An update regarding this matter will be posted as soon as possible.** ***WCA Competition Announcement Team***

items.name: Cubes Masters Zhytomyr 2019
items.information: **=UA=** Новини стосовно швидкубінгу в Україні публікуються на наших сторінках в [Телеграм](https://t.me/cubing_info) та [Фейсбуці](https://fb.com/cubingua). Обговорення змагань буде відбуватись в [Телеграмі](https://t.me/joinchat/H3RR0A9niaNkr21y6XvOdw). На змаганнях будуть також проведені 2 неофіційні дисципліни — розв’язання кубика 3х3х3 для дітей до 10 років та для дітей 10-12 років. Записатись на ці дисципліни можна буде на змаганнях, але дуже бажаний попередній запис за телефоном [+380633247832](tel:+380633247832). Вартість участі в неофіційній дисципліні — 30 грн. **=EN=** News regarding Ukrainian Speedcubing are published on our pages in [Telegram](https://t.me/cubing_info) and [Facebook](https://fb.com/cubingua). Discussion of the competition will be held in [Telegram](https://t.me/joinchat/H3RR0A9niaNkr21y6XvOdw). At competition 2 unofficial events will be held — solving of 3x3x3 Cube for kids under 10 years and for kids 10-12 years. Signing up for these events will be possible at competition, but it is highly recommended to sign up in advance by phone [+380633247832](tel:+380633247832). Participation fee in unofficial event — 30 UAH (~$1.5).

Обговорення змагань буде відбуватись в [Телеграмі](https://t.me/joinchat/D2eJoyBNuE-qxPgJ). На змаганнях буде проведена неофіційна дисципліна — розв’язання кубика 3х3х3 для дітей до 12 років. Записатись на цю дисципліну можна буде на змаганнях, але дуже бажаний попередній запис за телефоном +380 63 324 7832. Вартість участі в неофіційній дисципліні — 30 грн. Будь ласка, ознайомтесь з інформацією на вкладці COVID-19 для підвищення безпеки на змаганнях. *** News regarding Ukrainian Speedcubing are published on our page in [Telegram](https://t.me/cubing_info). Discussion of the competition will be held in [Telegram](https://t.me/joinchat/D2eJoyBNuE-qxPgJ). At the competition an unofficial event will be held — solving of 3x3x3 Cube for kids under 12 years. Signing up for this event will be possible at competition, but it is highly recommended to sign up in advance by phone +380 63 324 7832. Participation fee in unofficial event — 30 UAH (~$1). Please review the COVID-19 tab for information regarding steps taken to increase the competitor safety at this competition.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQyOTk4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b8a2a32ac5b3eb36e22a10a8db66703f0a66647a/Club%20de%20Speedcubing%20de%20l%E2%80%99Universit%C3%A9%20Laval.png) ### [FR] #### Série Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM/PM 2026 Une journée, deux compétitions! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecAM2026) et [Cubes Tranchés à Québec PM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecPM2026). Ces compétitions ont des épreuves différentes. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** des deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus d'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. #### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. #### Inscription gratuite pour les membres de CubingUL Les membres du Club de Speedcubing de l'Université Laval peuvent s'inscrire sans frais. Si vous êtes membre, inscrivez votre IDUL dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. --- ### [EN] #### Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM/PM 2026 Series One day, two competitions! You can choose between [Cubes Tranchés à Québec AM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecAM2026) and [Cubes Tranchés à Québec PM 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesTranchesaQuebecPM2026). These competitions have different events. You can only participate to ***one*** of the two competitions. ***If you register to both of them, only one registration will be accepted***. #### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. #### Free registration for CubingUL members Members of the Laval University Speedcubing Club may register for free by writing their IDUL in the registration comments

items.name: Cubestuff Grand Challenge Cape Town 2025

venue.name: The Commodore Legacy Hotel Cape Town
venue.details: The competition will be held in the outside terrace of The Commodore with the Americas Cup conference room as weather backup venue.

items.information: ## Volunteering Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTAzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--56311113734a1c22be204482adacfd1ca513311d/Commodore.jpg) **The Commodore Legacy Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see The Commodore Hotel tab for more information. ## Schedule Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## Notice of Filming Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ## NOTICE OF FILMING: Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## VENUE Oppi Dak is situated inside the Gateway Corner Centre. It is located on the first floor right above Liquor City and can be accessed via the stairs or the lift. The venue will provide a variety of food, snacks and drinks on both days and also offer card and cash payment options. venue.name: The Leonardo Sandton
venue.details: On the 45th floor of The Leonardo Hotel in Sandton

items.information: ## ABOUT THIS EVENT This competition will be the highest from ground level ever held in the World. This claim derives from our own research and is not an official measure from the WCA as the WCA does not track elevation or altitude as an official statistic. The competition will be held on the 45th floor of the hotel at 189m from ground level. It is also open for beginners to seasoned cubers alike. **Please note**: Due to capacity regulations, every competitor will only be allowed 1 (one) free spectator. We will have some additional spectator tickets to purchase at R100. Additional guests will be allowed on other floors of the Leonardo, however only those with spectator tickets will be allowed inside the cubing venue.

items.information: This competition is a twin competition with Cubetcha B 2021. You may only register for one (either A or B) of the two competitions. See the "Twin Competitions" tab for more details. # ***IMPORTANT: COVID SAFETY REQUIREMENTS*** Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, November 20th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, November 30th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. **YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.**

Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubetecCEFETTimoteo2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$20. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubetecCEFETTimoteo2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R${20. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk2MzgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--774c34e350648944c484408c3b4c95e9958e1dca/AACMHorizontal%20(1).png) **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- **🇺🇸 English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ¡Llega a Puebla el torneo CUBING BUAP! Un encuentro único donde los mejores speedcubers del país (tú podrías ser uno de ellos) demostrarán su talento en una competencia de precisión, velocidad y estrategia. La categoría principal será nada más y nada menos que el legendario 3x3, el clásico que lo inició todo. Un cubo, seis colores y una sola meta: ¡resolverlo en el menor tiempo posible! Si eres un cubero experto que busca romper su récord o si estás dando tus primeros giros y quieres vivir la emoción de la competencia, CUBING BUAP es el escenario perfecto para ti. Habrá premios, regalos, emoción, y por supuesto… ¡muchos cubos girando al mismo tiempo! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEwMzI1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3f71e2a1b95fa4fafef2e35ef0a08955e9e0e708/LOGO%20OFICIAL%20CUBING%20BUAP.png) The CUBING BUAP tournament is coming to Puebla! A unique gathering where the country's best speed cubers (you could be one of them) will showcase their talent in a competition of precision, speed, and strategy. The main category will be none other than the legendary 3x3, the classic that started it all. One cube, six colors, and one goal: solve it in the shortest time possible! Whether you're an expert cuber looking to break your record or are just taking your first spins and want to experience the thrill of competition, CUBING BUAP is the perfect venue for you. There will be prizes, giveaways, excitement, and of course... lots of cubes spinning at the same time!

items.name: Cubing Express Buenavista 2025

venue.name: [CEN del PRI] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/PRxeKopX66Yha7Wj6)
venue.address: Av. Insurgentes Nte. 59, Buenavista, Cuauhtémoc, 06350 Ciudad de México, CDMX

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MzYyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0266135e5081fb6c7c2e4bbc209d6826f5bea87/CEB%20logo.jpeg) ***Español*** **¡Hola Cubers! Somos Cubers te invita y te da la bienvenida al Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!** La siguiente comptetencia oficial de speedcubing celebrada en el Auditorio "Plutarco Elías Calles" en el CEN del PRI ubicado en la colonia Buenavista, lugar de la antigua estación de ferrocarriles que conectaba con la mayoría de las rutas de Ferrocarriles Nacionales de México hasta 1997. Ven y desafía tus límites, pon a prueba tus habilidades, conoce muchas más personas con la misma pasión por el cubo, disfruta de las dinámicas que tenemos preparadas para ti y sobre todo prepárate para resolver tus puzzles de la manera más Express. Te esperamos en el Acceso 1 del CEN del PRI este 16 y 17 de agosto. ¡TODOS A BORDO DEL CUBING EXPRESS! *Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)* ***English*** **Hello Cubers! Somos Cubers invites you and welcomes you to Cubing Express Buenavista 2025!** The next WCA speedcubing competition will be held in the "Plutarco Elías Calles" Auditorium at the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) located in the Buenavista neighborhood, the site of the old train station that served most of the Mexican National Railways (FERROCARRILES NACIONALES DE MÉXICO) routes until 1997. Come and challenge your limits, test your skills, meet many more people with the same passion for cubing, enjoy the dynamics we have prepared for you, and above all, get ready to solve your puzzles in the most Express way possible. We'll see you at Access 1 of the PRI's National Center for Educational Development (CEN) this August 16th and 17th. ALL ABOARD THE CUBING EXPRESS! *This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA [regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)*

Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. 2. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). items.information: Пожалуйста, смотрите наш Инстаграм аккаунт(https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Вся информация по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. ВНИМАНИЕ!!! 1. Участник не достигший 16 лет, обязательно должен быть в сопровождении совершеннолетнего. Родители, родственники или опекуны несовершеннолетнего участника СОГЛАШАЮТСЯ, с тем, что они несут полную и личную ответственность за безопасность несовершеннолетнего участника в период и на территории проведения соревнований. 2. Допуск участников в помещение будет производиться: - по приложению Ashyq согласно эпидемиологическим нормам действующим на момент проведения соревнований; - с соблюдением масочного режима (при себе иметь 5 масок на 1 день), - исключительно по предварительной регистрации, - при наличии документов удостоверяющих личность. 3. Все участники должны быть задействованы в судействе, скрамблинге, и должны пройти регистрацию до 11.15 часов, не зависимо от времени участия в своих дисциплинах. 4. Организаторы не несут ответственности в случае отмены соревнований, в связи с ухудшением эпидемиологической ситуации. Взнос будет возвращен в полном объеме. 5. Подача заявки на участие и оплата взноса означает, что участник полностью ознакомлен и согласен с правилами проведения соревнований. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Please see the website(https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). All information about competiotion will be in our Instagram. ATTENTION!!! 1. A participant under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Parents, relatives or guardians of a minor participant AGREE that they bear full and personal responsibility for the safety of a minor participant during and on the territory of the competition. 2. Admission of participants to the premises will be made: - according to the Ashyq application in accordance with the epidemiological standards in force at the time of the competition; - in compliance with the mask regime (have 5 masks for 1 day with you), - only by pre-registration, - in the presence of documents proving the identity. 3. All participants must be involved in judging, scrambling, and must register before 11.15 hours, regardless of the time of participation in their disciplines. 4. The organizers are not responsible in case of cancellation of the competition due to the deterioration of the epidemiological situation. The fee will be refunded in full. 5. Submission of an application for participation and payment of the fee means that the participant is fully acquainted with and agrees with the rules of the competition.

items.name: Cubing Party Xela 2022
items.information: "Cubing Party Xela 2022" será la segunda competencia en el país este año. Se tendrán protocolos de bioseguridad por pandemia y los requeridos por la WCA, para permitir la realización de competencias con el mejor ambiente posible. Se deberá usar mascarilla todo el tiempo, habrá alcohol en gel y se tomará la temperatura al entrar a la competencia. Se aceptará como máximo un acompañante por competidor. ________ "Cubing Party Xela 2022" will be the second competition in the country this year. There will be biosecurity protocols due to the pandemia, and those required by the WCA as well, to allow a good environment while holding competitions. Use of face mask is mandatory all day, also there will be gel alcohol and temperature will be measured at the entrance. A maximum of one guest will be allowed for each competitor.

items.information: This Fewest Moves competition is part of CubingZA's South African National Championship for 2023, but is being hosted in three separate venues across the nation, namely Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban. Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. In between each attempt to break up the day will be breaks where we may compete in some unofficial relay events, like 3BLD relays, Guildford or Mini-guildford challenges, team-solving, or 2x2-7x7 relays. More information will be released about these closer to the competition. **GUESTS** Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

items.information: **Deutsch** Wir, das Orga-Team von Cubing in HD 2023, heißen Euch willkommen zur ersten Competition in Heidelberg in der Geschichte der WCA! Wir freuen uns auf Euer zahlreiches Erscheinen und rege Teilnahme. Weil dies das erste Turnier ist, das in Heidelberg ausgetragen wird, würden wir uns auch sehr über Euer Feedback freuen! **English** We, the organising team of Cubing in HD 2023, welcome you to the first ever competition in Heidelberg, in the history of the WCA! We look forward to seeing many competitors and active participation. Because this is the first competition held in Heidelberg we would also very much appreciate your feedback!

We are looking forward to an exciting weekend in the castle town at the river Neckar. Please note that the venue has changed compared to Cubing in HD 2023.

items.information: Welcome to Cubing on Par 2023! Please note that this is part of a series, with an A and B competition happening on Saturday on Sunday. This competition (A) is happening on **Saturday, April 22nd**. See the [Series Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingonParA2023#25962-series-competitions) tab for more information. Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. For example, if you're only competing in events that are on Saturday, then you don't need to come on Sunday. Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 1 guest each. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.

items.name: Cubo Azul Guadalajara 2025

venue.name: [PRI Estatal Jalisco](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yL2kAJUSCB6pd6XVA)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTIyOTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c8e7880920b71a70254e01ebbfdca580b90e8b0c/cubo_azul_con_fondo-01.png) **¡Vuelven los Big Cubes a Guadalajara!** Despues de casi dos años desde la ultima vez **Cubo Azul Guadalajara 2025** cuenta con *3 rondas de todas las categorías NxN.* El nombre de la competencia hace alusión al Parque Agua Azul, cercano a la sede del evento, además referenciamos al mariposario de este mismo parque en el logo de la competencia. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia. **¡Big cubes are back to Guadalajara!** After almost two years since the last time, **Cubo Azul Guadalajara 2025** has *3 rounds of every NxN event*. The name of the competition is inspired by the park Parque Agua Azul, located near the event venue. The competition logo also references the park’s butterfly house. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

items.information: 🇧🇷 Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuboemEtapasVilaVelha2024/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuboemEtapasVilaVelha2024/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience!

items.information: Varmt välkomna till Cuboss Open 2023! Detta blir en väldigt speciell tävling, där WCA-grenarna blandas med en mängd olika specialgrenar. items.name: Cuerpo Central Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBazFNIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b542e5df21aec156a65eb62f13d6a54e186cde47/Logo_CO2023__1_-removebg-preview.png) **Español** ¡Damos la bienvenida a todos los apasionados del cubo y a los curiosos intrépidos a Cuerpo Central Open 2023, el torneo de speedcubing que desafiará mentes, romperá récords y desatará la emoción competitiva! En este emocionante evento, los cuberos más hábiles del mundo se unirán para resolver el enigma tridimensional con velocidad y destreza asombrosas, creando una atmósfera de camaradería y adrenalina. ¡Que los cubos giren a tu favor y que la competición comience! **English** Welcome to Cuerpo Central Open 2023, the speedcubing tournament that will challenge minds, break records, and unleash competitive excitement! In this thrilling event, the world's most skilled cubers come together to solve the 3D puzzle with astonishing speed and dexterity, creating an atmosphere of camaraderie and adrenaline. May the cubes turn in your favor, and let the competition begin!

Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). ❗️**IMPORTANTE** Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) 💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵 Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. 🇬🇧 **English:** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). ❗️❗️**IMPORTANT** This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page. 💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵 In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page. If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** Sejam todos bem-vindos à mais uma competição Capivara em parceria com o Colégio SEB Dom Bosco! Esta é uma edição muito especial, em homenagem ao Mês da Mulher. Para celebrar essa data tão importante, teremos pódios femininos em todas as modalidades, incluindo a categoria iniciante. Chamem suas amigas e venham comemorar conosco esse momento de reconhecimento e valorização! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=OQ1vLrsJVqagiDna). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). **English** Welcome to one other Capivara competition in partnership with *Colégio SEB Dom Bosco*! This is a very special edition, held in honor of Women’s Month. To celebrate this important occasion, we will have female podiums in all event categories, including the beginner category. Invite your friends and come celebrate this meaningful and empowering moment with us! Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYxMjMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--a8a1527578165f7fff36c2d7efa956563247f838/WhatsApp%20Image%202024-08-27%20at%2017.43.44.jpeg) ##### Español ​ **¡Bienvenidos a D'Amicis Puebla 2024!** ​ Cierra los ojos e imagina... Un torneo en fechas patrias con puente, en una de las mejores ciudades para dar el grito de independencia, un mix de **9 categorías**, y darte la oportunidad de disfrutar del cierre de temporada de los deliciosos Chiles en Nogada. ​ Puebla, la tierra del Chile en Nogada, te invita a divertirte y disfrutar de este próximo torneo. ​ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **"INSTITUTO D'AMICIS S.C"**. ​ D'Amicis Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ​ **¡Welcome to D'Amicis Puebla 2024!** ​ Close your eyes and imagine... A tournament on holidays, in one of the best cities to celebrate "El Grito", a mix of **9 categories**, and the chance to enjoy the end of the season for the delicious Chiles en Nogada. ​ Puebla, the land of Chile en Nogada, invites you to have fun and enjoy this upcoming tournament. ​ This competition is possible thanks to the support of the **"INSTITUTO D'AMICIS S.C"**. ​ D'Amicis Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.name: DFW Megacomp 2024
items.information: This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. * If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. items.information: **Português** O DNFools Boulevard 2023 é o 14º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** DNFools Boulevard 2023 is the 14th Official Competition of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, the cube may not be accepted for the competition.; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/51/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/51/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/51/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information: Pris og registrering Registreringen koster 100 dkr, og er forudbetalt. Der er plads til 90 deltagere Transport Tog til Roskilde st. Og så Bus 123 mod Valby eller 600S mod Hillerød til Ros torv (stopper lige udenfor venue). Tjek rejseplanen.dk Regelsæt Denne konkurrence følger WCA regelsættet, det er derfor forventet at alle deltager er bekendt med dette. Alle deltagere er derfor også underforstået med at deres resultater vil blive publiceret på WCA's hjemmeside, inklusiv navn, nationalitet og køn. Betalingspolitik Aflysning: Hvis du tilmelder dig konkurrencen, men du ikke kan komme og du informerer os via e-mail, før den 3. juni, 2016 vil vi overføre halvdelen af ​​den betalte afgift tilbage. Redigering af registrering: tilføje events: Skriv en mail med hvilke events du vil tilføje før 3. juni 2016. Redigering registrering: fjerne events: Skriv en mail med hvilke events du vil fjernes fra før 3. juni 2016. Registreringer uden betalinger: De registreringer uden betaling, vil blive slettet efter tilmeldingsfristen. (3. juni 2016.) Acceptering af registreringer: Vi betragter en registrering for gyldig, når registreringen er færdig, og tilmeldingsgebyret er betalt. Vi vil først acceptere tilmeldingen efter begge disse betingelser er opfyldt. Overnatning Plads til 70 personer til overnatning på venue. Det er først til mølle princippet, og det er gratis. Kontakt Camilla (fam.nielsson@gmail.com ) Indkvartering kan fra fredag aften. Man kan overnatte fra fredag til søndag.

items.information: Get ready for UC Davis's first cubing competition! This competition has **four rounds of 3x3**! ### **Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.** ### **If you are under the age of 18, UC Davis will require a parent/guardian to sign a liability waiver. An email will be sent out before the competition with more details.** #### **Competition Day Timing** * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Lunch will end at the scheduled time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. items.information: ### COVID NOTICE - Due to guidance from Arapahoe County, All competitors and spectators *MUST* either be fully vaccinated or recieve a negative test within 96 hours to enter the competition. Regardless of status, everyone is required to wear a mask at all times. Competitors may only bring one guest maximum with them into the venue. Outside spectators are prohibited. ### NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS ALLOWED INSIDE THE BALLROOM This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. We kindly ask you to read the **Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety tab** before registering. Due to COVID-19 restrictions, the competitor limit for this competition is 80 competitors. Competitors are being asked to bring only one spectator maximum to the competition, and if possible, to attend alone.

items.name: DeNxNver 2024
items.information: Welcome back for a second reindition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers. All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering **How to Change/Cancel Your Registration** Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab. Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information: 1. Intent to change/cancel registration 2. Desired changes to registration 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund. The deadline to change/cancel your registration is January 12th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. **Waitlist Procedure** If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until January 12th at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

venue.name: Noordhoek Community Center
venue.address: Avondrust Cir, Chapmans Peak, Cape Town, 7979

items.information: **INFORMATION** CubingZA is excited to announce Deep South Solving 2024! This competition is mainly focused on the less popular events, from bigger NxNs like 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7, to side events like megaminx and clock, and even blind events! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see Registration Requirements below. **MYSTERY PRIZES** We will include some fun prizes at this competition and there will be some interesting prizes to claim! **SPECTATORS** Competitors are welcome to bring 1 spectator with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video. Note: this competition has a much smaller competitor limit, meaning most rounds will not need runners as the majority of the rounds will be done with fixed seating.

items.name: Desafío Maipú NxN 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbGRmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4ce819179ad510ec318e2923166dc018caa0ee86/A%C3%B1adir%20un%20subt%C3%ADtulo.png) **Español** El Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 es un emocionante torneo de cubos Rubik que promete ser un evento de vanguardia en el mundo de los rompecabezas tridimensionales. En esta competición, entusiastas del cubo se reunirán para poner a prueba sus habilidades resolviendo cubos NxN, desde los clásicos 3x3 hasta los desafiantes cubos NxN de dimensiones superiores. Este torneo representa la oportunidad perfecta para demostrar destreza, estrategia y rapidez en la resolución de estos enigmáticos acertijos. Con una combinación de competencia feroz y comunidad apasionada, el Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 sin duda será un evento imperdible en el calendario de los amantes del cubo Rubik. **English** The Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 is an exciting Rubik's Cube tournament that promises to be a cutting-edge event in the world of three-dimensional puzzles. In this competition, cube enthusiasts will gather to test their skills by solving NxN cubes, ranging from the classic 3x3 to the challenging higher-dimensional NxN cubes. This tournament represents the perfect opportunity to showcase dexterity, strategy, and speed in solving these enigmatic puzzles. With a combination of fierce competition and a passionate community, the Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 will undoubtedly be a must-attend event on the Rubik's Cube lovers' calendar.

Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DesafioNipoBrasileiroBH2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$30. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DesafioNipoBrasileiroBH2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$30. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.
